title: Te Reo Manu
tagline: Learn to speak the language of birds
blurb: Five levels, built on real Xeno-Canto recordings. Name the bird behind each song, learn the tūī's five syllable types by ear, guess what it sings next, compose a phrase a tūī would believe, then read its regional dialects. Spun out of the Aotearoa Birdsong research.
